literal: Self-control among immortals will lead; lack of self-control dense darkness having led will leave.
translation: Self-control will elevate one to the realm of the immortals. A lack of self-control will plunge one into dense darkness.
modern: அடக்கம் ஒருவனை தேவர்களுக்கு இணையாக உயர்த்தும். அடக்கமில்லாத தன்மை அவனை மீள முடியாத காரிருளில் தள்ளி அழித்துவிடும்.
explanation: This couplet contrasts the ultimate destinations of those who possess self-control and those who do not. The word அடக்கம் (self-control) is shown as an elevating force that places a person among the அமரர் (immortals), representing the highest state of being. Conversely, அடங்காமை (lack of restraint) leads one into ஆரிருள் (dense darkness), symbolizing a state of profound ignorance and suffering. The auxiliary verb விடும் emphasizes the absolute certainty and finality of this ruinous outcome.
